description: Rowing teaches safe handling of a rowboat: hazards and first aid, the swimmer test and life jackets, launching, rowing a course and landing, swamped-boat and rescue drills, and the boats, oars and techniques of rowing.

safety.note: Rowing follows Safety Afloat with a qualified supervisor; pass the swimmer test and wear a life jacket.

outlineNote: The official page was updated in 2025, but the cached text appeared to be an earlier version, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include safety and first aid, the swimmer test, life jackets, launching, rowing and landing, swamped-boat and rescue drills, and boat and oar knowledge.
